# Lib.render.postfx

## Operators

- [**DepthOfField**](DepthOfField.md) — Adds a depth of field effect.
- [**GodRays**](GodRays.md) — Uses the z-buffer to draw god rays.
- [**MotionBlur**](MotionBlur.md) — Applies a post processing motion blur to a RenderTarget texture and its DepthBuffer.
- [**ProjectLight**](ProjectLight.md) — Renders light "godrays" from a projected image into a scene casting nice shadows.
- [**SSAO**](SSAO.md) — Adds a Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO) effect to a 3D rendered scene.
- [**TemporalAccumulation**](TemporalAccumulation.md)
